title: Selfhood feels non-object-like because it rests on control

statements.text: Vision gives objects because it makes epistemic, counterfactual predictions. Instrumental interoceptive inference instead gives a non-localized feeling of how well regulation is going, the felt background of mood, emotion and being a body.

sources.quote: Instead of delivering a phenomenology of objecthood, instrumental (control-oriented) interoceptive inference plausibly underlies a phenomenology related to the evaluation of the allostatic consequences of regulatory actions
